Appearance: Ayumu has a slim figure with orange hair that she ties into a bun on the right side and yellowish hazel eyes.

idols.name: Setsuna Yuki
idols.summary: **Background:** When Setsuna saw school idols for the first time, it felt like "fate" was calling out to her; the very reason for becoming a school idol herself. Seemingly always busy with school idol activities, Setsuna had become somewhat of an urban legend among the students at Nijigasaki, with many claiming they had never even seen her at school. Setsuna would always wear her idol outfit whenever she is with the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. But the girl that everyone knew as "Setsuna Yuki" had actually adopted that name herself, so that her parents would not figure out she was an idol. Setsuna comes from a strict household, where things like anime, manga, and school idols are banned. One reason why she became an urban legend is linked to the fact that she attends the same school as Nana Nakagawa, who has a different appearance than Setsuna. Along with Karin Asaka and Kasumi Nakasu, she works with Dengeki Online. The name "Setsuna Yuki" came from the characters of a light novel that Nana read. Setsuna is the student council president of Nijigasaki High School as Nana Nakagawa, although she loses her position to Shioriko Mifune in chapter nine of the School Idol Festival ALL STARS story. | **Personality**: Setsuna has an energetic smile and a distinctive style of performing. She's very friendly, charismatic and naturally people oriented. She is easily excitable and full of energy, and she can be moved emotionally very easily. She lights up whenever she is asked a question about her interests, which include anime, manga, video games, and school idols. While she is a very passionate geek and loves to talk about her otaku hobbies with her friends, due to her status as a serious and hard-working student council president, she feels she has to hide them from her mom. When the latter learns about Setsuna, she is happy with it and cheerfully goes to the concert. She takes her passions very seriously, and with regards to being a school idol, always wants to improve. She wants to share her love of school idols with the world, and help others feel more comfortable saying what they love, but she can be too passionate about idol activities, the reason that drove the members of the original School Idol Club apart and forcing her to disband the club afterwards. As Nana, she also strives to do well in school, so she always does homework as soon as possible and studies on her off days. Setsuna is also very kind and helpful, and is shown to be very supportive of her friends. For example, in the Dengeki 4-koma, she continued to eat Kasumi's spicy bread in order to not let her down since she cooked it for her and Karin. She tries to encourage everyone to pursue their dreams and is open to helping others with their dancing and singing. | **Appearance:** Setsuna is rather short with a slim figure. She has long bluish dark gray hair that she partly ties into a ponytail on the right side with a rose-shaped ornament and light grey eyes. As Nana Nakagawa, she wears glasses and ties her hair into two low pigtail braids instead. | **Club Role** Setsuna was the original founder of the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club.

idols.name: Anju Yuki
idols.summary: Background: Anju is a third-year student at UTX High School. Together with Tsubasa Kira and Erena Todo, they formed the school idol group A-RISE, which rose to popularity. Personality : Anju behaves like a princess who possesses a sweet voice and she doesn't seem to worry much about A-RISE's competitions nor is she bothered whenever people ask for their autographs, even from their opponents such as Nico Yazawa and Hanayo Koizumi. Appearance: Anju has a slim figure with long orange curly hair with straight bangs and purple eyes.

idols.name: Shioriko Mifune
idols.summary: Background: In All Stars, Shioriko is the second daughter of the prestigious and wealthy Mifune family. She challenges Setsuna Yuki for the position of student council president by initiating a re-election because she is dissatisfied with Setsuna's leadership. Shioriko believes that students should do things they can succeed at rather than follow their passions. She states that if she wins, she will disband the School Idol Club. However, after the School Idol Club convinces her to try out being a school idol, she joins the club. In the anime, Shioriko appears in the second season as a member of the student council. Rather than acting in opposition to the School Idol Club, she acts more neutrally, even briefly helping out with club activities. In The Memory of Dreams, it is revealed that her sister used to be a school idol and Shioriko admired school idols as a result. However, after her sister's group failed to get to Love Live, she began to hide away her love for school idols, out of a fear that she'd fail as one herself. After convincing by the club, she decides throw away her fears and becomes a school idol. Personality : Shioriko is described as calm and academically gifted. She values Japanese tradition and has been trained in traditional dance and flower arranging. She has a talent for identifying people's strengths and weaknesses, and uses this to help students at Nijigasaki High School succeed in their club activities by offering advice. In the game, she can be overly pragmatic, strict, cold and even antagonistic in her behavior; although people are initially upset upon hearing her suggestions, they become thankful when it leads to them succeeding. And despite her somewhat stiff demeanor and lack of self-expression, Shioriko is still a good person who genuinely wants to help others, and often yearns to connect with others deep down. Meanwhile, the anime version is vastly different; despite her serious and professional disposition, she is genuinely nice, polite, supportive and kind from the beginning. Even before joining herself, she always treated the NijiGaku with kindness, and when she accidentally discovered Setsuna and Nana are the same person, she promised to keep it secret. Clubs and Hobbies: As of Chapter 9 of the All Stars story, Shioriko is the Nijigasaki High School student council president, succeeding Setsuna. She spends time interacting more with the members of Nijigasaki, allowing her to understand their fulfilment of being idols despite other talents. In Chapter 17 of the main story, Shioriko officially joins the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club as its 11th member and 10th school idol. She enjoys using her spare time volunteering, and can be seen interacting with kids at the children's center, or picking up litter around the neighborhood. Appearance: Shioriko has a slim figure with semi-long dark green hair and vermilion eyes. She wears a small yellow hair ribbon on the left side.

idols.name: Takasaki Yu
idols.main_unit: Other - Nijigasaki High School Idol Club
idols.summary: Yu is Ayumu Uehara's childhood friend who lives next door in the same apartment complex. She is also the manager and song composer of Nijigasaki High School Idol Club. Seen as reliable and helpful, Yu uses her deep passion for idols to help the other club members achieve their goals.

idols.name: Mifune Kaoruko
idols.main_unit: Other - Nijigasaki High School Idol Club

idols.name: Kanon Shibuya
idols.favorite_food: Roasted apples, tomatoes, hamburgers, cafe au lait
idols.summary: **Background:** While singing has always been her most cherished pastime, Kanon is more likely to be seen helping her mother manage the family cafe, serving customers their special baked apples with cream. Kanon's father works as a translator and her grandmother is from Spain, whose homemade paellas are one of Kanon's favorite dishes. As her home, Kanon has had many fond memories of the cafe, with much of her time there spent alongside her childhood friend, Chisato Arashi. Together they would often interact with Kanon's pet owl, Manmaru ("Roundy"), who now serves as the cafe's ever-popular mascot. In the second season, she becomes the vice president of Yuigaoka's student council. | **Personality**: Kanon is seen as being somewhat shy and flustered, admitting that she is not good at communicating in front of others. However, while walking in town Kanon would often listen to music on her headphones, and would usually find herself singing the words to a song. Although she yearns to sing in front of people, Kanon is particularly nervous about doing so. Despite seeing herself as being very ordinary - having no particular talents or aspirations for her life - Kanon wishes to cheer people up through her favorite songs. Deciding to become a school idol was a way for her to do so, and to break away from merely seeing herself as simply "normal." But even though she thinks girly outfits are cute to look at, Kanon is a little shy and apprehensive about wearing anything too frilly or slightly revealing. Kanon, despite being more shy than previous protagonists Honoka Kosaka and Chika Takami, has nonetheless a natural charisma and people orientation. She is very kind-hearted, friendly, cheerful, passionate and supportive. She's a selfless and loyal friend, with sense of justice, and used to front bullies who threatened Chisato when they were children. She's shown to like animals, as seen when she plays with a stray cat on the street. She's very charismatic, with a magnetic personality and a natural affinity for people. Not only she loves to help others, she's also willing to befriend them, even when they don't treat her well at all, as seen in her interactions with Wien. It's also shown she can be idealistic to the point of being naive, finding good where more cynical characters wouldn't (for example, unlike Sumire, she didn't believe that Natsumi was actually the gold-digger she turned out to be). Despite her natural kindness, Kanon has a more boyish and blunt side, displayed when she's at home and in her more nervous moments. Though this happens mostly at the beginning, due to her personal frustration and considering herself a failure before she met Keke. | **Appearance:** Kanon has a slim figure with orange hair that reaches her shoulders and has purple eyes. | **Group Role:** Kanon serves as the leader co-composer, and co-lyricist for Liella! as a first-year, with the latter duties becoming shared with other members as time went on.

idols.name: Keke Tang
idols.summary: **Background:** Keke has a love for school idols after being inspired by Sunny Passion, which led her to make the move to Yuigaoka from Shanghai. Keke vows to work hard to become a school idol while living in Japan by herself, a country that also happens to be her mother's homeland. Her keen sense of style and fashion makes her an invaluable asset to girls like Kanon, whose wardrobe may occasionally be in need of someone with a more discerning eye. Seemingly the least fit member of the five, Keke would prefer to do almost anything in school besides gym class. Keke founded Yuigaoka's school idol club with Kanon. | **Personality**: A fun-loving and energetic optimist, Keke holds that the most important things in life are passion and a smiling face. To her, anything is possible if one never gives up, such as being a school idol. When dealing with tense or stressful situations, Keke often recalls the pithy advice her mother once gave: if her emotions were to ever run hot, it is best to "cool down" with sweets. Her mother's words being the likely inspiration for her sweet tooth, Keke believes that a scoop of ice cream can do more to wash away grouchy feelings than anything else, and could even bring about reconciliation among bickering friends. | **Appearance:** Keke has a slim figure with short gray hair with purple tints and curly tips and light blue eyes. | **Group Role:** Keke is the main costume designer and a co-lyricist for Liella!

idols.name: Chisato Arashi
idols.summary: **Background:** Chisato is the childhood friend of Kanon. Having an athletic spirit, she entered the school primarily to dance, but after a chance encounter with the other girls, Chisato would instead focus more on becoming a school idol. However, despite having an interest in school idols, Chisato initially didn't want to become one as she thought she was better off supporting Kanon instead. While attempting to also establish a dance club at Yuigaoka, Chisato strives to build up her physical fitness each day, often devoting mornings to long-distance running. Perhaps stemming from her love of cooking and intense fascination of round objects, Chisato works as a part-timer at a takoyaki food truck, which can be seen parked within Aoyama's "Commune" open-air food court. She became the president of the School Idol Club in her second year. She initially belonged to Yuigaoka's music program but made the decision to transfer to the general program after deciding to join Liella!. | **Personality**: Chisato is very kind, sweet, loyal and supportive towards Kanon - and later all the other group members. Although she describes herself as having a friendly and congenial personality, Chisato admits that others would find her "scary" whenever she gets angry - a thought that rarely crosses her mind. She loves to converse with her friends and go shopping together. Chisato is also very well-attuned to the latest news and rumors traveling within her school, seemingly to the extent that she might one day become Yuigaoka's official gossip girl. Chisato likes anything that is round shaped; especially Kanon's pet Manmaru, who seems to be wary around Chisato when she comes to visit. Her catchphrase is "Wissu Wissu Wissu!", "wiisu" (うぃーっす) being an informal Japanese greeting typically used by young males. She used to be bullied as a kid as she was meek and soft-spoken, and was defended by the more assertive Kanon. | **Appearance:** Chisato has a slim figure with white hair that is tied into high side buns, as well as dark pink eyes. | **Group Role:** Chisato is the primary choreographer for Liella! and also served as president of the Yuigaoka School Idol Club until graduating.

idols.name: Sumire Heanna
idols.favorite_food: Egg on rice, green tea, melon
idols.summary: Background: Sumire who lives with her parents and a little sister has always lived the life of a performer. Having been thrust into show business as a child, she intensely devoted her formative years to the craft of pleasing an audience. She avoided extracurricular activities in an attempt to balance such a life, but after entering Yuigaoka High, Sumire would enthusiastically take on the idea of becoming a school idol. Sumire lives at a shrine and often helps out as a maiden. She enjoys studying Japanese and Japanese history. Personality : Being in the entertainment world for so long, Sumire believes her experience and knowledge of its workings is second to none. Somewhat of a prima donna, Sumire assumes that most people already know her name. Somehow attached to the idea of her own stardom, Sumire dreams of becoming a famous school idol not just in Japan, but "across the galaxy." But Sumire also takes her more earthbound duty as a shrine maiden very seriously, warning those like Kanon to not aimlessly ask the gods to do everything for them, such as helping them become school idols. Instead, Sumire believes that they should do their best together without help from the gods and make their own wishes come true. Sumire was shown to be a confident character who was very self-assured. However, this was most likely a mask. Through a few episodes, we see Sumire always being chosen as second place. Her goal is to become world famous or something similar. However, she feels like she is always the second option and that is clearly shown in episode 10. She feels like she's the worst, so she always acts like she's the best. At the end of episode 10, we finally see Sumire embracing her emotions. Her catchphrase is "Galaxy~!!!". Appearance: Sumire has a slim and tall figure with long legs, long hime cut blond hair, melon green eyes, and wears a red headband. She possesses the feminine beauty ideals of an all-round natural beauty.

idols.name: Ren Hazuki
idols.summary: **Background:** Ren is dedicated to enriching the lives of her fellow students, as the school's responsibilities were handed down to her by her mother. Her home is very close to the school, and likewise separated from the hustle and bustle of the city. Ren studies calligraphy, art, English, ballet, and practices swimming, but she is particularly adept at playing the piano and performing as a figure skater. Ren comes from a background of affluence and high class, with her growing up in a mansion. Her family situation is a bit complicated; her father left them to go work overseas due to disagreements with her mother, who worked hard founding Yuigaoka in the place of her old school. Her mother shortly passed away due to health complications, which left Ren alone with a maid. Ren, thus, feels obligated to help sow the seeds of a great school, one that many hard-working and upstanding students will want to flock to so that she can fulfill her mother's dream. Her mother used to be a school idol back in her days, she specifically became one to save her own school from shutting down, failing to succeed; Ren took on the aspiration of becoming a school idol from her. Because, however, Ren couldn't find any records of her mother's school idol days, she assumed her mother regretted being a school idol for failing to save her school, Ren then grew to dislike school idols and tried to shut down Kanon and Keke's aspirations for ebbing school idols. It is only later that it was revealed to her, by Kanon, that her mother regrets nothing of her school idol days. In Season 2 Episode 5 of the anime, Ren plays on a game console at Keke's house, which led to her becoming hooked to playing games, as she is also shown playing a game on her phone before all of the girls go home for the night, where Kanon also mentions that Ren is hooked on playing games. In Season 2 Episode 7, Ren is shown to be addicted to video games, with her father sending various game consoles over to her house from overseas, which absorbed her into the world of gaming. Even at school, she plays games on her phone, and once imagined playing a game on her phone during practice, while the other girls, such as Chisato and Keke, think is most likely dozing off due to lack of sleep. Because of her addiction to playing games, she decided to keep it a secret from the other members because she imagined they'd probably make fun of her if she told them about her addiction of playing games. However, one day, at the clubroom, she told everybody about her addiction of playing games, which led to everybody else going to Ren's house and playing games with her. Ever since then, Ren has not been worried about keeping her addiction of playing games a secret anymore, and is more than happy to talk about it anytime. | **Personality**: Ren is polite and speaks with a very formal tone, although she is not quite used to handling casual conversations. Having been told as a child to refrain from spending too much time online, she also has difficulty communicating on camera. But considering that Ren is a fairly disciplined individual who manages her time well, she could easily dispense with any form of small talk. Ren believes that she mainly takes after her own mother, given her own unwavering commitment towards making Yuigaoka the number one school in her city. While she was a bit too serious at first, Ren mellows out since joining Liella! and shows her true personality; she's certainly responsible and diligent, but also friendly, kind, and good-natured, also showing quite a playful streak. She also seems to have quite the naïve side to her, shown through her curiosity and innocence of video games and many other things. She's easily slightly embarrassed about these traits, her formal tone sometimes falling apart. Overall, she is still very responsible, reliant, resilient, and one for order, and is accepted by the members of Liella! and those who respect her. | **Clubs and Hobbies:** Ren loves to play video games after being introduced to them by Keke | **Appearance:** Ren has a slim figure with long black hair that she has tied into a high ponytail with a white and pastel blue ribbon and has hazel eyes. | **Group Role:** Ren serves as the primary composer for Liella! until later sharing this duty with Mei.

idols.name: Mia Taylor
idols.summary: Background: She was brought to Nijigasaki (more specifically "dragged") by her friend Lanzhu Zhong. She was first introduced in Chapter 19 of Love Live! School Idol Festival ALL STARS. Despite coming from a family of esteemed musicians, Mia would much rather prefer the life of a homebody and eat nothing but burgers. Mia is considered a 'music prodigy' by Lanzhu; she was an American college student before immediately transferring into Nijigasaki as a third year due to her skills, despite only being 14 years old. In Chapter 29 of the main story, Mia officially joins the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club as its 12th member and 11th school idol alongside Lanzhu. Personality : Mia is a very straightforward and competitive girl, to the point of declaring war on the player as a songwriter out of the blue. However, her confidence is a façade and she actually tends to feel insecure about her songs' quality compared to the player's. At some point, she tried to determine why she felt this way despite being convinced that her own songs were better than the player's and went to discuss the other girl's songwriting skills with Rina, who suggested she get closer to the player in order to better understand her. Appearance: Mia has a slim figure with boycut-styled platinum silver hair and has grey eyes. She also has a visible silver rectangular earring on her left ear.

idols.name: Lanzhu Zhong
idols.summary: Background: Lanzhu applied to Nijigasaki with her good friend Mia Taylor. She is childhood friends with the current student council president, Shioriko Mifune. She was first introduced in Chapter 19 of the All Stars story and since Chapter 20, she is the leader of the Association, which she created as a way to help the members of the Club, which she admires greatly, to improve by working with professionals she hired. She initially banned the Club in order to force its members to join the Association but later allowed it to exist again in parallel with it until the latter's subsequent dissolution in Chapter 28. In Chapter 29, Lanzhu apologizes to the Protagonist about her previous actions and officially joins the School Club as its 13th member and 12th school idol alongside Mia. Personality : Since she was a kid, Lanzhu was treated as a gifted girl due to her noticeable talents in many fields. However, this generated insecurity in her as she was always eventually left by others because she was treated as "special" and not as an equal among her peers. Despite showing herself as a charismatic girl, her unique personality tends to catch others off guard by how demanding she can be with them so that they achieve excellent results like her, which leads her to make questionable decisions and to treat people in a way that usually makes them feel insulted. Even so, she doesn't hesitate to seek every possible way to befriend others. Lanzhu shows herself to be very competitive and somewhat arrogant in the anime, though, she doesn't appear as hostile and rude towards the Club as in the game. Appearance: Lanzhu has a slim figure. She has long pinkish platinum-colored hair that she styles into tied pigtails on both sides of her head and light greyish blue eyes. She has a beauty mark under her right eye. In the anime, she has high hair loops on top of her pigtails instead.

idols.name: Mao Hiiragi
idols.summary: Favorite Spot: The only traffic light on Kozushima & Mt. Tenjo Background: Mao Hiiragi was born and raised in Kōzu-shima, and has a strong connection to the island and its people. In the second prologue to From The Passion Island, she recognizes everyone who came to their show by name and has many memories with them. In her side story in Love Live! School idol festival she describes the island as "one big family". Along with Yuna Hijirisawa, she formed the school idol group Sunny Passion. Mao is close friends with Yuna Hijirisawa, and grew up with her on the island. In From The Passion Island, she describes Yuna as being "cheerful and energetic like the sun" and says she's "always bringing her new surprises". Yuna is the main reason she became a school idol, and says she likes being in Sunny Passion because she can pursue the same goal as Yuna. With Yuna by her side, she formed Sunny Passion with the goal to liven up the island they love. Just like Yuna, she helps Liella! despite their rivalry. She says she was initially drawn to them because "they shone so brightly". She believed that they were kind of people who could bring out the best in each other when they're together. Personality : Mao is called the "Sexy Night" of Sunny Passion because of her beauty and cool demeanor. Although she appears to be calm and collected at all times, she has a hidden emotional side as well. In From The Passion Island, Yuna says that despite being such a composed person, Mao gets very emotional when watching movies, and that she finds that side of her cute. Her life outside of being an idol is also quite ordinary, and she believes that if she hadn't become an idol, she would be a very boring high school girl. Mao's cool and mature personality contrasts with Yuna's infectious energy, and this contrast is one of the key features of Sunny Passion. When it comes to her role in Sunny Passion, Mao is in charge of gathering information as well as coordinating the practice menu. Her and Yuna work together on costumes and songs. The practice schedules she makes are very intense, and she's very strict about the two waking up early to practice often. Mao also teases Yuna often, such as in Volume 4 of From The Passion Island when she teases her about skipping out on ice cream to improve her figure. Appearance: Mao has long purple hair with pink highlights. She also has side-swept bangs. Her eyes are purple, and she has thick prominent eyebrows.

idols.name: Yuuna Hijirisawa
idols.summary: Favorite Spot: Maehama Beach & Akasaki Trail Background: Yuna was born and raised in Kōzu-shima, and has a strong emotional connection to the island. In Volume 1 of From The Passion Island, she recounts hearing about the island's declining population, and that many of her friends from middle school moved to the city for high school. Wanting to help the island, she formed Sunny Passion with her childhood friend Mao Hiiragi. She believes that by being school idols, they'll be able to make the island more lively and show everyone how great it is. Yuna has a close relationship with Mao, having grown up with her on the island. She admires Mao for her calm and composed personality and for keeping her in check when she gets out of control. She even goes as far as to say she's "the best partner she's ever had". She's also a bit jealous of Mao's figure, and hopes her limbs can grow longer so she can look more mature like Mao. Just like Mao, she helps Liella! despite their rivalry. She says the reason she cares about them is because she sees similarities between them and Sunny Passion, as they both started out inexperienced and continued being idols because of their love for singing with friends. Although her and Mao are on friendly terms with Liella!, they make it clear that they still intend to beat them in the Love Live! competition. Personality : Yuna is described as the "Sun" of Sunny Passion for her cheerful personality and bright smile that warms people's hearts. She's talkative, kind, and friendly, and although she describes herself to Mao as someone who "saves her favorite foods and things for last," she can be impulsive and even impatient at times. In Volume 3 of From The Passion Island, she is scolded by Mao for shouting suddenly without any concern for the neighbors, and in Volume 5 she insists that her and Mao begin making costumes as soon as they get back home, even though they planned to start the next day. Despite her high energy, she can also be observant and insightful, such as when she gives advice to Chisato Arashi in Season 1 Episode 5 of the anime. Yuna's energetic personality contrasts with Mao's calm and composed demeanor, and this contrast is one of the key features of Sunny Passion. When describing her role in Sunny Passion, she describes herself as "the funny one" and Mao as "the straight man". In From The Passion Island, Mao Hiiragi describes Yuna as a straightforward person who gives her wings and that she became a school idol because Yuna was with her. Mao describes Yuna's sincere smile as one of her key traits, and says that her smile is what makes Sunny Passion shine. Mao also says she's great at coming up with ideas, and while Mao handles coordinating the practice schedule, they both work together on costumes and songs. Appearance: Yuna has green eyes and shoulder length yellow-orange hair, which she ties back in a ponytail. She's also unique in that she has shark teeth, and is the only character in the franchise to have such a trait.

idols.name: Kinako Sakurakoji
idols.summary: **Background:** Kinako transferred to Yuigaoka in Tokyo from the boonies of Hokkaido, as she has always dreamed of living in the big city. Kinako lives on her own, and isn't used to the big city. She was recruited by Kanon to become a school idol after getting lost on campus. Kinako thinks school idols are really pretty but thought it would be impossible to become one herself. But she decided to give it a go after seeing how dazzling Liella! was on stage. She becomes the secretary of Yuigaoka's student council, and Liella!'s second lyricist. Kinako has a habit of referring to herself in the third person and ends her sentence with "~ssu" due to her rural upbringing. Before joining the group, she spent a lot of her time outdoors since her family owns a ranch estate, and as a result she is great with animals. Kinako refers to Harajuku as the Hills people (ヒルズ族). Kinako has sisters, but how many she has is unknown, as confirmed in Season 2 Episode 6 of the anime. Kinako becomes the student council president following Ren's graduation. | **Personality**: Kinako isn't very athletic, and her grades are average. However, Kinako is a hard worker who does not back down easily from challenges. She is very good at understanding animals and how they're feeling. She's very kind, sweet and cheerful, and always happy to offer her support to the group. Despite being sociable, she's also a little shy and awkward at times. She has a tendency to be very loud and can be easily startled. She's somewhat eccentric and comes across as a bit of an airhead. However, she's shown to be level-headed at the end of the day. Her assessments can come off as innocently insensitive since she's honest to a fault. One example is when she thought Kanon was already the club president by virtue of Ren being the student council president and everyone else not being suited for it. | **Appearance:** Kinako has a slim figure with long brown hair that she ties into low twin tails with white ribbons, a braided crown and her straight bangs have a lighter brown ombre. Her eyes are deep green. | **Group Role:** Kinako serves as a secondary lyricist for Liella! alongside Kanon.

idols.name: Mei Yoneme
idols.summary: **Background:** When Mei was younger, she was often mischaracterized as a delinquent due to her "scary eyes", which in reality turns out to be a side effect of her poor eyesight. This affected the way she perceived herself, and thought she didn't suit being a school idol, despite liking them a lot. She initially enrolled in Yuigaoka to watch Liella! from a distance as a fan, and had no intention in joining the group until she was personally invited by the club members after they saw how passionate she was about them. Mei has been friends with Shiki since middle school. She becomes the president of the School Idol Club following Chisato's graduation. | **Personality**: Mei speaks to strangers in a rather abrasive tone and comes off as frightening to other students, but she is actually very shy and has a diehard adoration for school idols that she keeps secret out of fear of being judged. Mei gets embarrassed when she is called "cute". After joining, Mei starts to come out of her shell, and becomes much more comfortable being herself around her new friends. Her tone of speaking changes from sarcastic and dry to calm and soft during live performances. She is very close with Shiki, and confides in her regularly about her troubles. | **Appearance:** Mei has a slim figure with red hair that is tied into a side bun and has blue eyes. | **Group Role:** Mei assists in composing music for Liella! and becomes President of the School Idol Club upon Chisato's graduation.

idols.name: Shiki Wakana
idols.summary: **Background:** Being one of the school's only science club members, Shiki can usually be found spending her free time in the science club room inventing strange gadgets, one of which being a pair of robotic roller skates. Shiki grew up as a loner until meeting Mei in middle school, and the two have stuck together since becoming friends. She becomes the vice president of the School Idol Club, at Mei's request. | **Personality**: Shiki is a stoic girl who has difficulty expressing herself. She isn't very fond of loud places. Her favorite things are Mei, stag beetles and butterflies. She appears to have a calm demeanor and is quiet most of the time. She also does not smile much, but the reason why is yet to be determined. She is also very conscious of her surroundings, as she easily noticed Mei looking at her from the Science Club room while she is with the other Liella! members at the rooftop. At her core, Shiki is a kind and well meaning girl who does her best to support her best friend; initially becoming a member of the school idol club on a trial period in an attempt to bait Mei into joining. Eventually, she officially joins the group in order to spend more time with Mei and bond over their newly found shared interest. However, despite her gentle nature, Shiki can become noticeably jealous, clingy and possessive when Mei spends time with others, as well as remarking about Mei's looks almost every chance she gets. She has a strange unexplained habit of blurting out English sentences at random occasions. Shiki prefers to stay in the shade, as the light is too bright for her. She has a habit of fainting when placed in situations that are too much for her. | **Appearance:** Shiki has a slim and shapely figure with short blue hair, reddish-brown eyes and a full lower lip. She tucks her hair behind her left ear, where she wears a small red earring. | **Group Role:** Shiki will occasionally create choreography for Liella! and becomes Vice President of the School Idol Club upon the graduation of the first generation members.

idols.name: Natsumi Onitsuka
idols.summary: Background: Natsumi was a small L-Tuber before debuting as a school idol. She hopes being a school idol will help her gain more of a following on her channel so she can earn more money. After losing a lot of her money to the stock market, she works at a few part time jobs, including "Lber Eats" and a moving company (as shown in Season 2 Episode 3 and Season 2 Episode 4 respectively). Season 2 Episode 5 reveals that she does not have many followers as a L-Tuber, which prompts her to become a "producer" for Liella! and upload vlogs of them on L-Tube in order to make more money, as they generate more views on L-Tube than her own personal channel. Natsumi has a younger sister named Tomari Onitsuka. Personality : Natsumi has a friendly demeanour, but can also be rather manipulative and selfish; she initially gets involved with Liella! to take advantage of their growing popularity to obtain money and internet fame through ad revenue as a social media influencer. Somewhat similarly to Sumire, Natsumi also spent her childhood trying to break into different fields of entertainment before eventually giving up, albeit with the sole intention of making money. After spending enough time with the group and enjoying a weekend at the Sakurakoji family's cabin in Hokkaido, she took a genuine liking to the charm of school idols. When it comes to Tomari, Natsumi constantly praises her when she gets the chance to. Natsumi frequently ends her sentences with "~desu no". Her catchphrase is "OniNatsu!" Appearance: Natsumi has a slim figure and blonde to pink ombré hair tied in the front in twin braids with small bows, and wears a white flower just above her right ear. She has hot pink eyes.

idols.name: Margarete Wien
idols.hobbies: Making sweets, Classical music, Clay target shooting
idols.summary: Background: A girl from Vienna, Austria; the youngest daughter of an important musical family. She has been called a prodigy for singing since she was a little girl. In order to follow her older sisters' footsteps, Margarete tried to enroll in a prestigious music academy in Vienna, but she failed the entrance exam. However, her parents decided to give her a second chance, and they made a deal with her involving Love Live, which is famous enough for people in Vienna to know about it. If she wins first place in the Love Live, they will use their influence to get her admitted to the academy as a transfer student. Determined to achieve her dreams, Margarete decided to travel to Japan in order to participate in Love Live. After Liella! was chosen to advance to the finals of Love Live!, Margarete's family suggested bringing Kanon back with her to Austria instead and learn music from her, much to her disagreement. Once graduating from middle school, Margarete enrolls in Yuigaoka and forms her own school idol club in an attempt to take down Liella! on her own terms. Margarete picks up a part time job working at the Shibuya family cafe, and reluctantly lives with Kanon's family during her stay. Personality : Margarete is a cold-blooded, passionate and stoic girl, who can act recklessly or overdramatically when fussy. She is extremely competitive and outright hostile to other idols she sees as threats. Originally signing up as a Love Live! contestant as a solo idol in her final year of middle school, she boldly makes it known that she has no interest in either school idols or Love Live! other than setting out to prove she can easily win the competition by herself. Once forming a unit with Kanon, Margarete slowly reveals her kinder side, but she never loses her competitive nature. Margarete isn't fond of people who don't put in a lot of effort, as shown when she argues with Tomari who has been skipping practice. Appearance: Margarete has a slim figure with long, purple hair that is curly, with half of her hair being in a braid along the top of her head. Her eyes are green in color. When she was a third year junior student, she wore a uniform consisting of a red vest, black jacket and a white collared shirt with a black tie. As a Yuigaoka student, she wears a uniform consisting of a dark blue blazer, a black shirt and skirt and a white collared shirt with a red ribbon.

idols.name: Tsubaki Rurika
idols.summary: A sophomore and daughter of the president of Tsubakisakuhana Girls' High School. She's not the type to lead things on her own, but she's a straightforward girl who naturally attracts people around her. She has a spoiled temperament, but she is the type to cherish the promises made once. She can also look stubborn because of that. While studying hard to live up to her mother's expectations, she has an idol who she secretly supports. Her favorite subject is Creatures and her special skill is that she can sprint.

idols.name: Sumeragi Yuzuha
idols.summary: Sophomore. She is the daughter of the owners of a large hospital. She is Rurika's childhood friend. She's a very understanding person. She's the honor student type, but she's too serious and she's inflexible in some ways. She is not good at standing out, she is reserved and considerate of others. She hates exercising. Her favorite subject is Music, and her special skill is playing the alto saxophone.

idols.name: Amakusa Hikaru
idols.summary: Sophomore. She has a straight and bold personality. She is refreshing and has a positive perspective in everything. She can see things objectively and doesn't like insects. She's in the basketball club and good at Physical Education. Her special skill: Ball games in general.

idols.name: Hojo Yukino
idols.summary: Although she's a junior, she's always around Rurika and the others. She has the highest academic ability in her grade, but has a laid-back personality. She especially loves Rurika, and although she hopes to be useful someday, she's not good at competing with her. Her favorite subject is English and she's very good at cooking.

idols.name: Mikasa Maya
idols.hobbies: Collecting weird keychains from her travels
idols.summary: Among the members, Maya is particularly knowledgeable about things like anime and idols. She is naturally clumsy, but sometimes says the right thing at the exact right time. She is everyone's mood maker. At her parent's request, she was sent to a cram school and entered a preparatory school, but she is not good at studying. Her favorite subject is home economics, and she's very good at making animal sounds.

idols.name: Takizawa Anzu
idols.summary: The daughter of the president of Takizakura Girls' Academy. she is a sophomore. She has loved singing since she was very young, and she recently became in charge of the most popular club at her school: the school idol club. She has a strong sense of responsibility and justice. She is very caring and interested in volunteering abroad. She is not good at tidying up and organizing. Her favorite subject is Society, and she can play the piano very well.

idols.name: Wakatsuki Misuzu
idols.summary: She is the head of the idol club at Takizakura's performing arts course. She is self-assertive, hardworking and studious. For that reason, she does not compromise on herself or others. She wants to continue performing arts activities in the future, and in the idol club where she is the director, she always faces the members severely. She doesn't like numbers. Her favorite subject is National language, and she's very good at calligraphy.

idols.name: Kurusu Toa
idols.summary: She admired Anzu so much that she enrolled in Takizakura Girls' Academy. She has a serious and fearless personality, and she is the type to say what she thinks. She has a cat tongue and doesn't like hot things. Her favorite subject is Art and she's good at Kendo.

idols.name: Harukaze Sayaka
idols.summary: She is a member of the entertainment course idol club. She has a positive and bright personality. While she values ​​individuality and personal time, that means she dislikes group activities and is very self-conscious. She prioritizes the individual over the team, aiming for her center position. She is not good at getting up early and being punctual. Her favorite subject is Chemistry, and she's good at talking to animals.

idols.name: Suzuka Rena
idols.summary: She is a member of the entertainment course idol club. She is taciturn and respects team discipline. She values ​​cooperation and hates individual play. She likes puns and will tell one whenever she gets a chance... but rarely gets a chance. She often laughs at her own jokes. Her favorite subject is Math and she's a good dancer.

idols.main_unit: Hasunosora Girls' High School Idol Club
idols.summary: **Bloom Garden Party Movie Description:** x | **105th Term / 3rd-Year Description:** A third-year at Hasunosora Girls’ High and one of the two presidents of the School Idol Club. Kaho has a dazzling smile and a cheerful personality. She always dives head-first into anything that looks fun. Kaho's goal as a school idol is to “blossom”, and to create a stage where a bunch of people can also blossom. Her family runs a flower farm in Nagano, and she has twin younger sisters who are in elementary school. | **104th Term / 2nd-Year Description:** A second year at Hasunosora Girls’ High. Kaho has a dazzling smile and a cheerful personality. She always dives head-first into anything that looks fun. Her goal as a school idol is to “blossom” and one day perform live in front of one million people. Her family runs a flower farm in Nagano, and she has twin younger sisters who are in elementary school. | **103rd Term / 1st-Year Description:** An energetic Hasunosora 1st year who never stops smiling. She entered the academy with high expectations and the goal of "blossoming". She puts all her energy into things she enjoys, and sometimes goes in unexpected directions. Her family runs a flower farm in Nagano, and has younger twin sisters. | **Background:** Her family runs a flower farm in Nagano, and she has twin sisters who are years younger than her, named Futaba and Minori. Kaho was frequently ill as a child, leading her to have a more restrictive childhood. Although her health stabilized in grade school, Kaho's parents continued to be extremely overprotective of her, which frustrated Kaho to no end as they stopped her from hanging out with friends and doing fun activities, taking her to and from school each day with a strict curfew attached. Her admission to Hasunosora is the result of her negotiating with her parents for a long time to attain her freedom. Her mother also attended Hasunosora. She had no prior musical expertise before entering the academy, instead qualifying through her entrance exam alone. | **Personality**: An energetic girl who has a smile on her face no matter what. She entered the academy with high expectations and the goal of “blossoming”, as her parents heavily restricted her freedom beforehand. Blossoming, according to her, is how others looked while freely enjoying their daily lives. She thought this way of living was beautiful, comparing it to flowers you can't look away from. She thinks that by attaining freedom, she can blossom too. Kaho's greatest fear is being left alone, likely stemming from her lonely childhood. This loneliness combines with her eager attitude, making her a tad too friendly towards strangers (such as Sayaka), and she noted as a talkative person. Fortunately, this cheerful personality also allows her to make friends quite easily. She approached Sayaka Murano on the train just because of their shared uniform, despite never meeting her before, instantly sparking a conversation. Sayaka was uncomfortable at first, forced to listen to her eager ramblings, but the two were still able to become friends rather quickly. She initially hated the academy upon realizing it's strict rules, including an exact curfew, discipline, and needing written permission to leave school grounds. This culminated in a plan to escape, but after the coaxing of Kozue Otomune, she realized school idols could help her enjoy it in her own way. She ended up wanting to make Hasunosora more fun for the students, despite not wanting to take part in the club originally. She is a kind-hearted, friendly, cheerful, passionate, welcoming, and supportive person who strives to make everything fun for everyone. She puts all her energy into what she enjoys, although can become somewhat impulsive and charge ahead in the wrong direction. | **Appearance:** Kaho is a girl with pale skin. She has greenish-teal eyes, beige rose hair that reaches the tip of her shoulders, bunny hairclips on two small strands of hair, and often smiles. | **Group Role:** Kaho is the co-president of Hasunosora's School Idol Club following the graduation of the 102nd class. This role was passed on to Ginko prior to her graduation.

idols.name: Sayaka Murano
idols.main_unit: Hasunosora Girls' High School Idol Club
idols.hobbies: Making and researching bento (Checking commercial boxed lunches and station lunches)
idols.summary: **Bloom Garden Party Movie Description:** x | **105th Term / 3rd-Year Description:** A third-year at Hasunosora Girls’ High and one of the two presidents of the School Idol Club. Sayaka is an athlete who has performed as a figure skater from a young age. She is very sincere and never leaves others behind. Although Sayaka is very diligent and takes care of others, she can be somewhat of an airhead at times. She is a very skilled cook and uses the dormitory kitchen often. | **104th Term / 2nd-Year Description:** A second-year at Hasunosora Girls’ High. Sayaka is an athlete who has performed as a figure skater from a young age. She is very sincere and never leaves others behind, and although she is very diligent and takes care of others, she can be somewhat of an airhead at times. She is a very skilled cook and often takes care of Tsuzuri. | **103rd Term / 1st-Year Description:** A Hasunosora 1st year who is clumsy, but is a genuine hard worker. She was a figure skater when she was little, and although her grades are good, she still has some worries... She is a serious person who finds it difficult to ignore others and is determined to help them with their troubles, but she can also be a bit air-headed. | **Background:** Sayaka is also an accomplished figure skater in addition to being a school idol. The whole reason that she came to Hasunosora was because she stopped progressing as a figure skater; after being told that she "was not expressive enough", she wanted to figure out how she could grow beyond that. She was attracted to the School Idol Club after seeing Tsuzuri Yugiri's performance and immediately accepted an invitation to join. Sayaka has an older sister named Tsukasa who was known as an exceptional skater until her injury two years prior. Sayaka is determined to continue figure skating for her sister, with her being the reason she took it up in the first place. However, her fatal flaw was that she tried to emulate her sister exactly, losing her expressiveness and uniqueness through trying to replicate someone else. | **Personality**: Sayaka is awkward, but also a genuine hard worker who doesn't give up when times are tough. Even though her grades are good, but she has trouble when it comes to her personal life. This is because she can be too serious, even giving simple lunchboxes her all. She also can't bring herself to neglect other people, and can unintentionally give help where it isn't wanted. Upon entering Hasunosora, she initially had no desire for friends, likely because of her lack of humor and sometimes clumsy social skills. Sayaka is very formal and always makes sure to address others formally. She is more reserved and stiff than her fellow 1st years, Kaho Hinoshita and Rurino Osawa, and often worries that her stiffness might drive others away. However, these mannerisms prove invaluable for her relationship with Tsuzuri; by listening patiently and nudging her along with questions, Sayaka can help her sort out complicated situations. This dynamic between Sayaka's grounded nature and Tsuzuri's light and airy personality allows for a successful partnership. She is unable to leave others alone when they need help, as is shown in her relationship with Tsuzuri. Sayaka wakes her in the mornings, makes her lunch, takes her to practice, and generally keeps her on track. Kozue Otomune expressed pity towards taking care of her, but Sayaka doesn't mind the added responsibility, even finding new joy in cooking after making Tsuzuri's bentos. idols.name: Megumi Fujishima

idols.summary: **Bloom Garden Party Movie Description:** x | **105th Term / 1st-Year Description:** A first year at Hasunosora Girls’ High.
